A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same study and complete 14-page documents, including Appendices A–G. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish identical content apart from the first-page arXiv version/date stamp and its associated link.

before.justification: v4 reports original evaluations of five LLMs on three literature-review tasks, disciplinary analyses and human validation in Section 4, with ANOVA results in Appendix G.

after.justification: v5 retains the original five-model experimental results, disciplinary analyses, human validation and Appendix G statistical results.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the identical three-task evaluation framework, reference-matching rules and scoring procedures. The task prompts in Appendix A are also unchanged.

E1.justification: Both use the same 1,105 Annual Reviews articles published in 2023 from 51 journals, with identical disciplinary coverage and reference generation, abstract writing and review composition tasks.

E2.justification: Tables 1–3 retain Qwen-2.5-72B, Llama-3.2-3B, DeepSeek-V3, GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet. Table 4 retains the same DeepSeek and Claude comparison.

E3.justification: The model versions, temperature 0, ten-reference requests, approximately 1,000-word reviews, ten extracted key points and evaluation metrics are unchanged. Section 4.5 retains the same 100-reference, three-annotator validation design.

E4.justification: The publication-year and metadata analyses, cross-disciplinary comparisons, citation-frequency analysis and human validation are identical. Appendix C's reference comparison and Appendix F's generated example are also retained unchanged.

E5.justification: Both retain the same ANOVA procedures and p-value reporting in Appendix G, correlations in Section 4.4 and kappa reporting in Section 4.5. Neither adds repeated-run, seed or uncertainty-interval reporting.

E6.justification: All numerical entries, plotted results and qualitative findings match. For example, Claude-3.5-Sonnet's precision remains 51.59 in Table 1 and KPR remains 62.32 in Table 3; human-validation accuracy remains 86% with kappa 0.71.

T1.justification: The dataset and task definitions, reference-validity conditions and metric definitions in Equations 1–8 are identical. No mathematical assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same evaluation-framework contributions and findings about persistent reference hallucinations and disciplinary variation.

C2.justification: Section 4 and Appendix D retain the same explanations concerning joint review/reference generation and training-data familiarity. The limitations concerning metric coverage, possible data contamination, metadata normalization and incomplete reference retrieval are unchanged.

D1.justification: Model identifiers and settings in Section 4.1, prompts in Appendix A, normalization instructions in Appendix E, and the code/dataset repository access information are identical.

R1.justification: Section 2, citations throughout the paper and the bibliography are unchanged. The relationship to prior literature-review generation and reference-hallucination research is retained.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes from v4, dated 18 June 2025, to v5, dated 21 August 2025, with its corresponding version link. All substantive prose, headings, section order and appendix structure are identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1–6, Tables 1–5, captions and page layout are unchanged. Rendered pages match outside the version/date stamp text accounted for under P1.

improvement.justification: v5 updates only the arXiv version/date stamp and associated link. The complete main text and appendices retain identical scientific content, evidence, explanations and presentation, establishing no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
